description: Phase 6bl gate — WITH RECURSIVE CTE. Iterative fixed-point evaluation: anchor UNION ALL recursive-self-reference.

cases.name: recursive-count-to-five
cases.description: Classic counter: generate integers 1..5 via self-reference.

program.sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM c WHERE n < 5) SELECT n FROM c ORDER BY n;

cases.name: recursive-sum-via-cte
cases.description: Use the recursive CTE as a source for an aggregate.

program.sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM c WHERE n < 10) SELECT SUM(n) FROM c;

cases.name: recursive-tree-walk
cases.description: Parent-child traversal using a physical table.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE edges (parent INTEGER, child INTEGER);
WITH RECURSIVE d(node) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT child FROM edges, d WHERE edges.parent = d.node) SELECT node FROM d ORDER BY node;

cases.name: recursive-without-explicit-keyword
cases.description: `WITH` without `RECURSIVE` still works if the CTE is self-referential — RECURSIVE is a hint, not a gate.

program.sql: WITH c(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM c WHERE n < 3) SELECT n FROM c ORDER BY n;

cases.name: recursive-union-dedup
cases.description: UNION (not UNION ALL) dedups ACC at each step — values are not re-appended.

program.sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT (n % 3) + 1 FROM c) SELECT n FROM c ORDER BY n;

cases.name: recursive-arity-mismatch
cases.description: Anchor and recursive branch column counts must match.

program.sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(a, b) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM c) SELECT * FROM c;

cases.name: recursive-with-column-list
cases.description: Explicit column-list overrides anchor projection names.

program.sql: WITH RECURSIVE fib(i, a, b) AS (SELECT 1, 0, 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1, b, a + b FROM fib WHERE i < 6) SELECT i, a FROM fib ORDER BY i;

cases.name: recursive-depth-cap
cases.description: Iteration cap at 1000 — an always-non-empty recursive branch triggers the error.

program.sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM c) SELECT n FROM c;
